free_tier.stated: Cloud VPS Host IPV6 at USD 1.00/month, with USD 5.99 shown struck through as the list price and 'Save 83%' beside it, billed USD 12.00 per year in the page's annual view: quoted as '1 c / 40 t', 1 GB RAM, 10 GB disk on RAID 50, a /64 IPv6 only, and marked 'Semi-Annual/Annual billing only'. The page marks it 'Most Popular' and 'Chosen by 62% of our customers'. The tracker instead lists USD 5.99/month for a different, larger product: 3 cores, 6 GB RAM, 500 GB HDD, 10,240 GB/month in Los Angeles. Re-read 2026-11-07: the order page still shows USD 1.00 per month against the USD 5.99 strike with Save 83 percent, billed $12.00/yr, and the plan card still lists 'Semi-Annual/Annual billing only'. The WHMCS store group page manage.digirdp.com/store/ssd-vps-hosting lists the same product as 'SSD VPS Host IPV6' starting at GBP 1.13 monthly (the store's currency selector also offers USD, INR and EUR) with 'Semi-Annual/Annual billing' in the card features and an Order Now button, so the plan is in stock. No page read prints a renewal price. The cart itself renders no price to a cookieless or direct read: the site cart page renders prices client-side, a direct cart read of manage.digirdp.com answered HTTP 403, and a cookieless read of the store resolves to the default product group.
